title: Return a rounded value
prompt: Write `nearest`, which takes a decimal and returns the nearest whole number as an int. `solve` returns nearest(x). 2.6 becomes 3.
hints: round() gives the nearest value but as a float; int() turns it into an int.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.

docs.name: round(x)
docs.what: Returns the nearest whole number as a float.

docs.name: int(number)
docs.what: Returns the number as a whole number, dropping the decimals.
